title: U Mass - Insulin Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xznfp5e

steps.title: Prepare Microplate
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the microplate to room temperature prior to opening the foil pouch.

steps.title: Assign Microplate Strips
steps.instruction: Assign microplate strips for duplicate measurement of standards, controls, and samples.

substeps.instruction: Store remaining strips at 2~8°C in the tightly sealed foil pouch with desiccant.

steps.title: Load Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Pipette either 5 µL or 25 µL of each standard, control, and sample into respective wells.

substeps.instruction: For 5 µL sample volume: use standard concentrations of 0.188, 0.5, 1.25, 3.75, and 6.9 ng/mL (C-G) and Control Levels 2 and 3.
For 25 µL sample size: use standard concentrations of 0.025, 0.09, 0.188, 0.5, and 1.25 ng/mL (A-E) and Control Levels 1 and 2.
Refer to Reagent Preparation and Certificate of Analysis for control reconstitution instructions.

steps.title: Add Conjugate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Pipette 75 µL of Working Strength Conjugate into each well.

substeps.instruction: Cover microplate with a plate sealer.
Incubate for 2 hours at room temperature while shaking at 700~900 rpm using a microplate shaker.

steps.title: Wash Microplate
steps.instruction: Decant the contents of the wells and wash the microplate 6 times with 350 µL of Working Strength Wash Buffer per well.

substeps.instruction: Use a microplate washer, or alternatively, fill wells with Working Strength Wash Buffer using a wash bottle with a nozzle (multichannel pipettes are not recommended).
Dispense wash buffer with adequate and equal force.
Between washes, invert the microplate to discard liquid and firmly tap on absorbent paper towels.
After the final wash, remove any residual Wash Buffer and bubbles by inverting and firmly tapping the microplate on absorbent paper towels.

steps.title: Add TMB Substrate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of TMB Substrate into each well.

substeps.instruction: Cover microplate with a plate sealer.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature while shaking at 700~900 rpm on a microplate shaker.

steps.title: Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of Stop Solution into each well.

substeps.instruction: Gently shake the microplate to mix contents.

steps.title: Read Absorbance
steps.instruction: Place the microplate in a microplate reader capable of reading absorbance at 450 nm.

substeps.instruction: Analyze the microplate immediately after adding Stop Solution and within 30 minutes.
